name: BProgram Structure & Invariants
description: Verifies that BProgram and event classes are structured correctly.
testCode:
from helpers import BProgram
bp = BProgram()
assert bp.threads == [], 'Initial threads list must be empty'
assert bp.history == [], 'Initial event history must be empty'

name: Positive Behavioral Threads Verification
description: Checks that add_hot_water and add_cold_water yield valid synchronization specifications.
testCode:
from main import add_hot_water, add_cold_water
gen_hot = add_hot_water()
spec_hot = next(gen_hot)
assert 'request' in spec_hot and 'HOT_WATER' in spec_hot['request'], 'add_hot_water must request HOT_WATER'
gen_cold = add_cold_water()
spec_cold = next(gen_cold)
assert 'request' in spec_cold and 'COLD_WATER' in spec_cold['request'], 'add_cold_water must request COLD_WATER'

name: Safety Monitor & Block Verification
description: Ensures that the overflow prevention b-thread correctly blocks pumping events when capacity threshold is reached.
testCode:
from main import overflow_prevention
safety = overflow_prevention()
spec = next(safety)
assert 'block' in spec, 'overflow_prevention must return block specifications'

name: End-to-End Simulation Trace Execution
description: Runs the coordinator and ensures that no unhandled deadlock or crash occurs during full simulation.
testCode:
from helpers import BProgram
from main import add_hot_water, add_cold_water, overflow_prevention
bp = BProgram()
bp.add_bthread(add_hot_water)
bp.add_bthread(add_cold_water)
bp.add_bthread(overflow_prevention)
trace = bp.run(max_steps=15)
assert len(trace) > 0, 'Simulation must dispatch events successfully'
assert all(isinstance(e, str) for e in trace), 'All dispatched events must be strings'
